name: LE Audio unicast
description: A source driving a sink's ASE and streaming to it over a CIS. The format expresses this today; the loader does not host the audio_source role yet (device::cis_central and profiles::ascs_client are being wired), so running this scene is refused by name rather than half-executed. The sink is the catalog's Volume Control device, which is the LE Audio peripheral that exists today.
